concept.title: Categories not yet in a group
concept.shortdesc: These categories sit alone in the clustering hierarchy, so the grouping step named no group for them. A person deciding the final structure would place each one.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Hiring a meeting room, hall, function room or other venue space for meetings, events, training or private functions.
: Getting information, talks and peer support for people affected by stroke, including groups and courses about life after stroke.
: Getting information or advice about finding, applying for or managing volunteering, including rights, benefits, overseas options and setting up volunteer schemes.
: Taking part in archery, target shooting, airsoft and shooting clubs, with related firearms facilities.
: Free introductory, taster or trial sessions that let a person try an activity or class before committing.
: Testing, treatment, care, advice and education about sexual health, sexually transmitted infections, HIV and blood borne viruses.
: Help with taking, managing and prompting medication, plus related information about prescriptions and prescribed treatments.
: Receiving foot care such as chiropody, podiatry and nail cutting, along with related grooming services like hairdressing and wigs.
: Festive events for children and families such as meeting Santa in a grotto, receiving a gift, and Christmas crafts, treats and lights events.
: Playing board games, card games, bingo and similar table games with others, including game clubs and cafe sessions.
: Cleaning and light housekeeping services such as domestic cleaning, laundry and carpet or upholstery cleaning.
: Advice, information and casework on housing problems, such as rights, rent arrears, eviction, repairs, landlords and applications.
: One-to-one or specialist help to find, apply for and keep work, including CV writing, interview preparation and supported employment.
: Borrowing books and other items from a library or lending library, with some related access to resources.
: Advice and help to save energy and cut fuel bills, including tariffs, insulation, grants, energy suppliers and small energy-saving measures.
